notes: Render view name (blender/bridge_gen.py cameras) paired with the inspection photo it should resemble. Winter photos (Jan 2022): bare fields, dry grass, low sun.

pairs.caption: North profile
pairs.check: 3 flat slab spans, deep coping with vertical parapet on top, 20 deg skew, 9 black piles per bent standing in shallow water, riprap slopes under the bridge, W-beam guardrail on the approaches

pairs.caption: South profile
pairs.check: South profile: same elements from the other bank; abutment face visible above the riprap

pairs.caption: Road alignment looking east
pairs.check: Two-lane asphalt road, double yellow centre line, white edge lines, concrete approach slab, guardrail flares, flat farmland

pairs.caption: Top of deck condition looking east
pairs.check: Deck surface between two vertical concrete parapets, 36 ft between curbs

pairs.caption: Span A underside condition
pairs.check: Flat slab soffit, integral pile cap, round black-coated piles, riprap slope to the abutment

pairs.caption: Span B underside condition looking north
pairs.check: Pile bent in water, 9 piles ~4.5 ft apart, cap flush with slab soffit, water about 13 ft below the deck

pairs.caption: Upstream channel alignment looking north
pairs.check: Channel alignment: creek meanders gently and runs roughly parallel to the bents (20 deg to the road)
